title: A homework item's answers
description: YAML front matter of course/assessments/answers/UNN-INN.md — the answers to one homework item (an item whose `usage` includes `homework` and not `in-class-quiz`), kept out of git (HW-D35): assessments/answers/ is gitignored, so they exist only on the computer where they were written. The question stays in assessments/items/UNN-INN.md, committed. Written by homework-item-writer through `classkit write`; read by item-critic, item-solver, `classkit validate` and the teacher's answers document.

id.description: The item's id; the file is named after it (`homework_answers_reference` checks the item exists).

correct.description: For multiple-choice, multiple-select and true-false: the labels of the correct choices.

rationales.description: Per choice label: why a student would pick it — for a distractor, the misconception it detects.

model_answer.description: The model answer, for open and numeric items.

rubric.description: How the item is graded — required in practice for open and code items.

expected_solution.description: For `format: code`: the runnable reference the item's `tests` are run against (`code_execution_reference_present`).

tests.description: For `format: code`: deterministic test cases (no wall-clock, randomness or network).
